title: Graphene Raman Standard Protocol
content: Graphene Raman analysis: the D band (~1350 cm-1) indicates defects, the G band (~1580 cm-1) indicates sp2 carbon, and the 2D band (~2700 cm-1) is used to determine the number of layers. Recommended laser: 532 nm, 10-30% power, 1-5 s exposure. Quantify defect density from the ID/IG ratio.

title: Biological Sample Raman Measurement Guide
content: Biological samples are sensitive to photodamage. Keep laser power below 40%. A 785 nm laser is recommended (fluorescence suppression). Main peaks: amide I (~1650 cm-1), CH2 (~2850 cm-1), C-H (~3000 cm-1). Minimize measurement time and improve SNR by increasing the number of accumulations.

title: Battery Electrode Raman Analysis
content: Li-ion battery electrode analysis: graphite anode G band (1580 cm-1), D band (1350 cm-1). LiFePO4 cathode characteristic peak near 950 cm-1. Observe peak shifts with state of charge. Recommended: 532 nm or 633 nm laser, power at or below 50%.

title: Silicon Raman Standard (Calibration)
content: Silicon reference peak: 520 cm-1. Used for spectrometer calibration. A full width at half maximum (FWHM) < 5 cm-1 is good. 10-20% power with 0.5-1 s exposure is sufficient.

title: CNT (Carbon Nanotube) Raman
content: CNT Raman: RBM (100-300 cm-1, diameter dependent), D band (1350 cm-1), G band (1590 cm-1), G' band (2700 cm-1). SWCNTs show observable RBM. A 532 or 633 nm laser is recommended.
